\]

\[

\]

\[
\sqrt{7!} = \sqrt{2^4 \cdot 3^2 \cdot 5 \cdot 7}
\]

\[
= \sqrt{2^4}\cdot \sqrt{3^2}\cdot \sqrt{5\cdot 7}
\]

\[
= 2^2\cdot 3\cdot \sqrt{35}
\]

\[
= 12\sqrt{35}
\]

The answer is \(12\sqrt{35}\).
